footer.tagline: Guhindura imyanda mu bukorikori, n'ubukorikori mu ngaruka.

home.heroSubtitle: RenewCanvas Africa ihuza ibikoresho byongera gukoreshwa n'abahanzi b'impuguke kugira ngo bakore ubukorikori budasanzwe bufite ingaruka zigaragara. Buri gice kivuga inkuru y'ihinduka.
home.aboutP1: RenewCanvas Africa ni urubuga rw'ubukorikori bw'uruziga rushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga, ruhindura ikibazo cy'imyanda kikaba urwaho rwo guhanga. Dukusanya ibikoresho byongera gukoreshwa byihariye, tukabiha abahanzi batoranyijwe, hanyuma tugahuza imirimo yabo idasanzwe n'abaguzi bashyira imbere kurambye n'ingaruka.
home.aboutP2: Buri gikorwa kuri urubuga rwacu kije n'inkuru y'ingaruka ku bidukikije yagenzuwe, ku buryo uzamenya neza imyanda yakuweho ingana iki, umuhanzi wakikoze, n'urugendo kuva ku byatawe kugeza ku gikorwa cy'agaciro.
home.aboutP3: Ntabwo turi isoko gusa. Turi umuryango ugamije kwerekana ko imyanda ishobora kuba nziza, ko abahanzi b'Abanyafurika bakwiye kumenyekana ku rwego mpuzamahanga, n'uko abaguzi bafite ubwenge bashobora guhindura ibintu by'ukuri.
home.howTitle: Kuva ku Myanda kugeza ku Gitangaza mu Ntambwe Enye
home.howSubtitle: Urubuga rwacu rushyiraho urugendo rugaragara kandi rushobora gukurikiranwa, kuva ku bikoresho byatawe kugeza ku bukorikori bukundwa.
home.step1Desc: Dukura ibikoresho byongera gukoreshwa (plastike, imyenda, ibyuma) ku bafatanyabikorwa bagenzuwe, tukabisukura tukabitondekanya ku bw'imirimo y'ubukorikori.
home.step2Desc: Abahanzi bacu batoranyijwe bahindura ibi bikoresho mu mashusho, ibishushanyo, imitako n'ibikoresho byo mu rugo bitangaje.
home.step3Desc: Buri gikorwa cyandikwa hamwe n'ingaruka zacyo ku bidukikije: kilogarama z'imyanda yakuweho, ibikoresho byakoreshejwe, n'amafaranga y'umuhanzi.
home.step4Desc: Gura ubukorikori budasanzwe, saba ibikorwa byihariye, cyangwa utange impano ku mashuri. Buri gikorwa gitanga ingaruka z'ukuri.
home.impactSubtitle: Buri kugura kuri RenewCanvas Africa bigira uruhare mu ngaruka zigaragara ku bidukikije no mu mibereho.
home.statArtistsDesc: Abaremyi b'impuguke binjira kuri urubuga rwacu
home.statArtworksDesc: Ibikorwa byihariye bifite inkuru z'ingaruka zagenzuwe
home.statToArtistsDesc: Bitangwa nyuma y'igihe cyo gusubiza cy'amasaha 48
home.whyTitle: Ubukorikori bufite Intego, Ingaruka zifite Ibimenyetso
home.whySubtitle: RenewCanvas Africa si isoko ry'ubukorikori nk'andi. Twubaka ubukungu bw'uruziga bugaragara kandi bushobora gukurikiranwa ku iremwa.
home.why1Desc: Buri gikorwa kije n'ingaruka ku bidukikije zanditswe: kg z'imyanda yakuweho n'ibikoresho byakurikiranwe.
home.why2Desc: Abahanzi bacu batoranywa ku bushobozi no ku murava. Urimo kugura ku baremyi b'impuguke bagenzuwe.
home.why3Desc: Twishimira ubuhanga n'ubunyabukorikori bw'Abanyafurika mu gukemura ikibazo cy'ibidukikije cy'aho.
home.why4Desc: Shyigikira impano ku mashuri, amahugurwa y'abahanzi, n'imishinga yo gusukura imiturire binyuze mu kugura kwawe.
home.ctaSubtitle: Niba ushaka kugura ubukorikori budasanzwe, kwinjira nk'umuhanzi, cyangwa gufatanya natwe ku ngaruka z'ibigo, hari umwanya wawe mu muryango wa RenewCanvas.

marketplace.heroSubtitle: Reba ikusanyirizo ryacu ry'ubukorikori butangaje bwakozwe mu bikoresho byongera gukoreshwa, usange ibice byihariye by'abahanzi bigenga n'ab'umwuga. Buri gice kije n'ingaruka ku bidukikije zagenzuwe.
marketplace.comingSoonDesc: Turi mu kwakira abahanzi b'impuguke no gutoranya ikusanyirizo ryacu rya mbere ry'ubukorikori budasanzwe bwongeye gukoreshwa. Ba uwa mbere kumenya igihe tuzatangira!
marketplace.lookingDesc: Iyandikishe kugira ngo umenyeshwe igihe isoko ryacu rizatangira. Bona uburyo bwo kubona mbere ubukorikori bwihariye bwongeye gukoreshwa bufite inkuru z'ingaruka zagenzuwe.
marketplace.areYouArtistDesc: Injira kuri urubuga rwacu werekane ibikorwa byawe byongeye gukoreshwa ku baguzi bashyira imbere kurambye. Dutanga ibikoresho n'ubufasha.

artwork.renewOwnedDesc: Aya ni amaduka y'urubuga. Amafaranga ni aya RenewCanvas nyuma yo kwishyura n'ikiguzi cyo kohereza.
artwork.artistOwnedDesc: Ubukorikori bw'umuhanzi. RenewCanvas ihuza kwishyura, kohereza, no gutanga amafaranga nyuma yo gutanga.

artistDashboard.welcomeSub: Genzura ubukorikori bwawe, ukurikirane amabwiriza, kandi uteze imbere ubucuruzi bwawe bw'iremwa.
artistDashboard.environmentalImpactDesc: Imyanda yose yakuweho binyuze mu bukorikori bwawe.
